member.name: T:SaveDex.PkhexBridge.NativeExports
member.summary: Raw-JNI spike: only used under `dotnet publish -p:PublishAot=true`, alongside <NativeLib>Shared</NativeLib> in the csproj. Exists to test whether the Android SDK's NativeAOT NDK cross-compilation setup (see dotnet-bridge/README.md) actually produces a loadable .so, before investing in real JNI marshaling for . Unrelated to /, which are the (ruled-out) automatic-JCW/Mono spike.
